title: None
subtitle: No panel: the icon is the node
description: No outline at all. The node is its icon, and the whole square is clickable.

This is the one deliberate exception to 'a click lands on exactly the pixels that were drawn' -- there are no drawn pixels to land on, so the square stands in for them. It is for a canvas where the icons are the map and an outline around each one is noise.
